payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
node.criteria: Apply the original rubric to R1. Return complete (yes) when s1 passes, establishing the requested chalk-drawing endpoint. Return partial only when s1 explicitly fails and s2 passes, establishing known incomplete fulfillment with requested progress. Return absent (no) only when s1 explicitly fails and s2 fails. Return unknown when s1 is unknown or invalid, or when s1 fails and s2 has no valid known result. A progress pass alone does not resolve whether fulfillment is complete. When s1 passes, s2 is conditionally skipped and remains unobserved; that skip is neither failure nor evidence of progress and does not block the established endpoint. Unrelated edits do not count as requested progress.
node.binding: Target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.. Reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing..
